title.narrative: GC7: Scaling Up Malaria Prevention, Treatment, and Control Interventions in Liberia for Sustained Impact. - Liberia (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Liberia, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Liberia)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria incidence and deaths by at least 80 percent of the 2016 (45% prevalence) levels by 2027 (9% prevalence) - MTR Report (2023). The objectives of this program are: By end of 2027, reduce malaria mortality rates by at least 89.5% (18/100,000 population) compared to 2016 (172/100,000 population). By end of 2027, reduce malaria case incidence by at least 80% (76/1,000 population) compared to 2016 (380/1,000 population). By end of 2027, promote and maintain a culture of evidence-based decision making to achieve malaria program performance at all levels. By the end of 2027, strengthen and maintain capacity for program management, coordination and partnership to achieve malaria program performance at all levels

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LBR-M-CRSP02
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of districts achieving national target for the proportion of confirmed malaria patients who received first-line antimalarial treatment
Percentage of districts achieving national target for the proportion of suspected malaria patients who receive a parasitological test
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Percentage of reporting units which triangulate programmatic/consumption data and logistics data on at least a quarterly basis
Proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics who received three or more doses of intermittent preventive treatment for malaria
Other CM-2a: Proportion of confirmed malaria cases under 5 years that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Number of insecticide-treated nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
